text_copy.text: Sonopet iQ's universal handpiece tip portfolio

text.text:
Take control

Choose from basic, advanced and wireless foot pedals and a hand controller* for remote control from sterile or nonsterile field.

Introducing Pulse Control

A new wave of brilliance

A new technology that gives you an added ability to regulate the resection of hard and soft tissues using the Sonopet iQ. Along with tip selection, power, suction and irrigation, Pulse Control’s five custom waveforms gives you a new way to manage resecting complex tissue.

Pulse Control:
 Extrasensory ultrasonics

text.text:
Your singular bone cutting solution

The Sonopet iQ system fulfills diverse needs through a single handpiece and console. With integrated power, suction and irrigation, you'll have the precise tips and touch needed to gain access, cut, reshape, repair and realign.

With Sonopet iQ's universal handpiece, customization capabilities, semi-autonomous functionality and simple setup, the Sonopet iQ system aims to expand your bone cutting capabilities while streamlining capital costs, staff training, workspace and inventory.

Introducing the
 37cm iQ Large Laparoscopic Tip

experiencefragment.text: Right-sized for MIS You asked for it and now its here – the 37cm laparoscopic tip for the Sonopet iQ Universal handpiece. Its our least invasive tip for general surgery applications – expanding the utility, maneuverability and performance of your ultrasonic tip portfolio. Combined with Sonopet iQ system’s simple set up and slender, low-friction sleeve, youll spend less time managing equipment and more time performing your best.6
